comments.text: Over 1 million homeless people in the 3rd largest economy in the world! The image of someone collecting bottles for deposit on a spotless street, right next to a luxury Porsche, is truly haunting. This video doesn’t just expose the truth about Germany; it’s a wake-up call for every developed nation: When housing costs outrun wages, the line between an ordinary life and sleeping on the streets is just one bad month away. Are you seeing this happen in your own city? 🇩🇪💔
